extensionDescription.message: A private YouTube watch-later list synchronized across your devices.

collectTabs.message: Add all open YouTube videos and close their tabs

addFailed.message: Could not add the video. Check your connection and try again.

cloudAuthRequired.message: Sign in to load and change the list.

cloudNotConfigured.message: Firebase is not configured for this build yet.

authIntro.message: Use the same email and password in the extension and Android app. The password is not stored.

resetEmailSent.message: If an account exists for this email, a password reset message has been sent.

authFieldsRequired.message: Enter a valid email and a password of at least 6 characters.

authTooManyAttempts.message: Too many attempts. Try again later.

authDisabled.message: Email sign-in is not enabled yet.

authFailed.message: Could not sign in. Try again.

exportEmpty.message: There are no videos to export.

importNoVideos.message: No valid YouTube videos were found in the selected file.

removeOnPlayTitle.message: Move a video to the cloud Watched section after synchronization confirms the change, then open it

supportIntro.message: LaterTube is free and ad-free. If you find it useful, you can send any amount in USDT.

qrTrc20Alt.message: QR code for the USDT address on the TRON TRC20 network

supportVoluntary.message: Support is completely optional and does not unlock additional features.
